001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.database;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
004import lombok.Builder;
005import lombok.Data;
006
007@Data
008public class ShopMetricRecord {
009
010  private final long v = 3;
011  private long time;
012  private long shopId;
013  private ShopOperationEnum type;
014  private double total;
015  private double tax;
016  private int amount;
017  private String player;
018
019  @Builder
020  public ShopMetricRecord(final long time, final long shopId, final ShopOperationEnum type, final double total, final double tax, final int amount, final QUser player) {
021
022    this.time = time;
023    this.shopId = shopId;
024    this.type = type;
025    this.total = total;
026    this.tax = tax;
027    this.amount = amount;
028    this.player = player.serialize();
029  }
030}
